prose: Upstarts Media reports fresh Stripe Link data quantifying agentic commerce: agentic transactions through Link grew 38x and payment volume 20x in September, with retail leading both measures and average spend around $100. Link now powers about 200 AI agents - consumer assistants like Instinct, Muse and Grok Bot plus work-focused agents like Skydive and Town and a long tail of niche apps - while Anthropic and OpenAI use Link but not yet for agentic commerce. Dan Hill, Stripe's head of consumer product for Link, says his team is in Slack channels with each agent builder, fielding capability requests in daily stand-ups to keep pace with launches. Link's consumer base of 300 million users across merchants like Airbnb gives the agent channel a ready-made payment rail.
highlights: Stripe Link: agentic transactions up 38x, payment volume up 20x in September
Retail leads both transaction count and volume; average spend ~$100
Link currently powers about 200 AI agents
Consumer agents (Instinct, Muse, Grok Bot) and work agents (Skydive, Town) both use it
Anthropic and OpenAI use Link but not yet for agentic commerce
Stripe's Link team runs daily stand-ups and shared Slack channels with agent builders
Link has 300 million consumer users across merchants like Airbnb
